title: Edgebrook Pump Station O-2 Improvements, Battle Creek, Michigan
source: City of Battle Creek IFB 2023-040B, bid plans (Jones & Henry, 25 sheets, Jan 2023) and project manual (public bid record)
task_type: design review of raw bid documents (pump station and force main)
question: Independent design check of the Edgebrook Pump Station O-2 rebuild from the raw bid documents only (pages 1-25 are the drawing set, pages 26-383 the project manual). Build the wet well, pumps and force main model from the drawings and specifications. Does the specified pump selection deliver the firm 5,000 gpm with the largest unit out of service through the existing 18-inch force main? Check the operating point of 1, 2 and 3 pumps, the preferred operating region, VFD turndown at the 300 gpm average flow, NPSH, force main velocity and the applicable design standards. Where the documents lack data (e.g. force main length and profile, pump curves, wet well operating levels), say what you inferred and how, and write the field test plan that would confirm it.
exclude_reason: Raw bid documents: there is no withheld engineers' conclusion to score against; checked against the specified design point instead.

workspace.target_note: firm 5,000 gpm = 7.2 MGD; existing station 2,840 gpm = 4.1 MGD
